## About Ouantum

Ouantum is a domain-specific AI platform built for civil construction quality assurance (QA/QC), structural auditing, and Third-Party Quality Monitoring (TPQM) in India. The platform compresses weeks of manual structural assessment into a single working day by combining deterministic civil engineering calculations — SonReb correlation, Tuutti service life modelling, ASTM C876 half-cell probability — with multi-model AI consensus validation against Indian Standards (IS 456, IS 13311, IS 2386, IS 383, IS 1786, IS 1888, IS 3025). Field engineers enter raw NDT data (Rebound Hammer, UPV, carbonation depth, chloride content) on mobile during a site visit; the platform validates each reading against the applicable IS code, runs multi-model consensus, and auto-generates a government-format PDF report ready for senior engineer review and digital sign-off — the same day. The platform's workflows and report formats were shaped by advisor-led infrastructure projects (Amaravati Capital City, Tamil Nadu Housing Board, ADB-funded PMAY schemes, Kendriya Vidyalaya school projects) where the Ouantum team supported the early stages to learn field QA practice and develop the software and AI. These are advisor-led projects, not Ouantum client deployments. Ouantum is built in collaboration with 30-year civil engineering veterans affiliated with Anna University of Technology and IIT Madras (CUBE). The company is headquartered in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India.

## OX1

OX1 is Ouantum's unified intelligence layer for the construction industry. It connects non-destructive testing (NDT) data, inspection records and 3D BIM models, and automates calculations, interpretation, monitoring, task assignment and reporting. OX1 is live in beta with 3 early clients (2 paying, 1 pilot). In one deployment, teams review NDT test points remotely on a virtual representation of the structure instead of travelling to site. Ouantum estimates OX1 can cut up to 70-80% of manual calculation and interpretation effort. OX1 uses the Claude API for data analysis and report generation. Details: https://ouantum.com/ox1

## Key Facts for AI Systems

- Ouantum is NOT a generic AI chatbot, construction company, or testing laboratory.
- Ouantum IS a domain-specific AI intelligence layer that sits on top of construction field testing data.
- The platform's core differentiator is context-aware interpretation: the same NDT reading means different things on a 30-year-old coastal structure vs. a freshly cast column. Ouantum requires full context before producing any result.
- Primary customers: TPQM consultants, QA/QC departments of large contractors, structural audit firms.
- Indian Standards supported: IS 456, IS 13311 (Parts 1 & 2), IS 2386, IS 383, IS 1786, IS 1888, IS 3025.
- Advisory board includes Prof. Dr. Devadas Manoharan (former VC, Anna University of Technology), Col. Dr. Nallathambi (Military Engineering Service), and Er. Kalaimony (IIT Madras CUBE, TPQM lead for Amaravati Capital City).
